stories.title: Trump calls Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz not 'acceptable'
stories.description: President Trump said he was rejecting an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian proposal is similar to a memorandum of understanding agreed upon by the U.S. and Iran back in June.

stories.title: Iran must stop arming Houthis in Yemen, G7 says ahead of UN General Assembly
stories.description: The G7 also condemns "in the strongest terms" Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, saying that the escalation in fighting in Yemen jeopardises global energy security.

stories.title: UK to help refuel Saudi jets countering Houthi attacks
stories.description: The UK says it will provide air-to-air refuelling for "defensive" operations following a request from Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Iran's president tells Trump it will never 'bend the knee'
stories.description: Masoud Pezeshkian's defiant speech to the UN comes after the US president threatened to "annihilate" Iran if a peace deal is not agreed soon.

stories.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
stories.description: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

stories.title: Houthis say they targeted Saudi capital with ballistic missiles
stories.description: A reported strike on a fuel depot at Riyadh airport caused delays on Saturday, as Saudi Arabia says it shot down a ballistic missile aimed at the capital.

stories.title: US and Iran hold first talks since June after Trump's 'annihilation' threat
stories.description: The talks are the first since a ceasefire collapsed in June, with the sides exchanging fire intermittently.

stories.title: UN experts say grounds to believe US committed war crimes in Iran strikes
stories.description: The US has not acknowledged carrying out February's deadly strikes on a primary school in Minab and a sports complex in Lamerd.

stories.title: US to allow Iran delegation to attend UN meetings in New York as war passes half-year mark
stories.description: The BBC understands Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi are among the delegates allowed to enter the US.

stories.title: Verified video shows wreckage of Saudi fighter jet shot down over Yemen
stories.description: BBC Verify tracks down the location of a Houthi video showing the wreckage of an F-15 they claim to have shot down.

stories.title: Who are the Houthis and what do they want?
stories.description: A rapid military advance down Yemen's Red Sea coast has put the spotlight on the Iran-backed group, amid growing concerns about the global energy market.

stories.title: Did the biggest week of diplomacy make headway in ending the US-Iran war?
stories.description: The UN General Assembly wraps up with mixed diplomatic outcomes.

stories.title: Araghchi ignores Trump, waits for mediators’ response on Hormuz
stories.description: Iran says it’s still waiting for an official response from the US on its proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Iran war live: Tehran vows not to back down as Trump rejects Hormuz plan
stories.description: US president rejects Iran's seven-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, saying the deal is not 'acceptable'.

stories.title: Pezeshkian says Iran ‘no longer trusts talks with Washington’
stories.description: Iran’s Pezeshkian says Tehran no longer trusts US talks, shortly before Trump rejected its Hormuz proposal.

stories.title: Saudi FM accuses Iran of ‘flagrant attacks’ and condemns Houthis at UNGA
stories.description: At the UN, Saudi Arabia accused Iran of attacks across the region and called for action against the Houthis.

stories.title: Iran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan
stories.description: "They want to make a deal where they open the Strait immediately because they're losing so badly. They want to make a deal and I think that's fine. I like making a deal too," the U.S. President said.

stories.title: Iran suggests deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days; Trump rejects proposal
stories.description: Iran's Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, who detailed the proposal in a private gathering on September 24 on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly, suggested that a speedy agreement would help U.S. President Trump ahead of November’s midterm elections
